findings.finding: Set A,B ages; a,b sweets. Equations: A+a=2(B+b); A·a=4B·b; A+(a-5)=B+(b+5); A(a-5)=B(b+5). Search integers (A,B≤200,a≥5,b≥0). Unique solution A=10,B=5 → product=50.
Key: From sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. Set a=20−A, b=10−B. Solve a·A=4b·B and a·(A−5)=b·(B+5) with A∈[5,19], B∈[0,9]. Unique solution (a,b,A,B)=(10,5,10,5). Product ages=10·5=50.
